description: bassemu~ is a Pure Data external that emulates a transistor-based analog bass synthesizer. It provides selectable saw, rectangular, triangular, and sine waveforms, resonant and high-pass filtering, and external-signal filtering.

research.notes: No standalone official GitHub or GitLab repository was verified. Version 0.3 was historically maintained under externals/bassemu~ in the official Pure Data community SVN; its tracker covered the wider Pure Data project.
